title: Lough Cullin and Drummin Forest Walk Route

images.title: Liz McCabe / Lough Cullen
images.caption: Lough Cullen. The level of Lough Cullen and Lough Conn was lowered 40 years ago by blasting the channel of the Moy to ease flooding. Boulders that used to be submerged are now high and dry on small beaches

images.title: Liz McCabe / Forestry path from Derrynagran to Lough Cullen
images.caption: Forestry path from Derrynagran to Lough Cullen

description: This walk visits Lough Cullin and Drummin Forest in County Mayo. The lough and woodland area are located just south of the larger Lough Conn. On the eastern side of the lake you'll find a parking area and viewpoint with access to a good sized beach. It's a lovely spot for a stroll along the water and a picnic. There's great views over the water to the surrounding hills too.East of the lough there's also some peaceful woodland paths around Drummin Forest to try.You can continue your walking in the area atLough Easkeyor on theEnniscrone Coastal Walk.
